review_text: The Airport is pretty decent in a lot of aspects The duty free is vast the airport staff and security are ultra professional helped me guide through the terminal on where to find my gate However the WiFi experience could have been better because doing facetime calls was a problem considering whatsapp is not allowed Anyhow it is massive

I fly into and out of Albany a few times a year on business For my money its one of the most efficient airports in terms of securityTSA in the country They get you in out and on your way with very little hassle the way it should be The airport itself isnt huge and doesnt have some of the amenities of a larger hub but as a traveller Im looking for efficiency and thats what Albany Airport provides

I want to commend staff at Alicante airport on what was my first airport visit post covid Arriving and departing was prompt and hassle free When I accidentally broke a mug at the Starbucks counter the staff were just concerned about how I was feeling Also the girl at the EasyJet gate took my postcards which I had forgotten to post and promised to post them for me They all arrived eventually so thank you

The terminal is Sovietstyle and a little big for just or flights a day to Moscow and the occasional charter Checkin was slow with initially only one desk open but the service was friendly and efficient when eventually obtained With a blizzard on the tarmac it was unsafe for the bus to drive out to the plane Stumbling across the whipped up snow and ice is not something for the fainthearted The early offer of an onboard drink was appreciated

A nice airport and frankly I am surprised at the bad reviews I arrived there at approx hrs Entry and checkin were very easy Security was straight forward and immigration was very easy Once on the airside a restaurant was open as were the dutyfree shops The only downside were the grumpy staff of the shops who obviously had not woken up yet Announcements were clear and boarding was orderly and we took off on time

I concur with the comment below Confins is underused But there is a big plus Conexao Aeroporto buses that take you to the city centre are punctual and efficient Things have changed since and there should be more improvements in the future

Quiet new airport opened in Check in was efficient Distance to Alona Beach only a few minutes Therefore very comfortable for people staying at the beach There are only few food stalls available Overall a fast and efficient airport

Very disappointed to see that you are busy aping the western culture and forget our own roots As an Indian I am very proud of my heritage and all my traditional food However Cochin airport is a far cry from that You will happily serve cappuccino coffee to please a foreigner while completely omitting to serve a traditional Indian masala tea or a nice bru coffee It is very sad what Cochin airport has come to

I first arrived in Damascus in Feb Since then I have been back and forth almost times a year since then I am an Englishman who met and married a Syrian girl in The airport in my view was more relaxed in the old days whereby you could check in and walk back into the loungecafe for tea etc with your friends and family

DUD is a small but efficient airport with everything you need Landed from Wellington bags out very quickly The airport is quite far from city centre mins cost nearly dollars by Taxi and dollars by super shuttle Departure is well organised checkin sufficient airline lounge is located upstairs security check right before you board

A generally good experience at Durban airport Arrival is quite simple and they seem to keep the touts out of the waiting area The checkin is well organized and immigration outbound proceeded quickly There are a number of shops and restaurants The food and the shopping are forgettable but not expensive Decent amount of seating at the gates Wifi works fine

A rather small airport serving Firenze I used the airport in the winter season so imagine it during the busy summer season Theres bus boarding only and max small gates It has a abundance of dutyfree shops and food beverages counters Prices are reasonable Staff is friendly and efficiently working

Return flights from Glasgow to Verona Check in was quick as was passing through security Facilities were alright bearing in mind our flight was at am Boarding was efficient Return again was stress free other than the automated passport gate refusing to let me through Baggage was already on the carousel when through security All in all a pretty good experience

Landvetter airport is a rather small one well organized and neat Security checks have seldom long queuing and are generally fast Lots of toilets are available very clean with taps to fillin bottles with water So do not hesitate to pass security with an empty bottle Shopping options are limited as the airport is small but the choice is more than correct This airport seems well managed

Guayaquils airport has most of the services that we have here in Australia they even offer jetways into planes There are restaurants ATMs machines banks coffee shops and entertainment it passed our expectations without doubt

Pretty basic as airports go Way out of town it is simply ridiculous and taxis are well keep your belt on and wear a helmet if you have one The airport sort of works but this is a typical domestic Chinese airport not great not entirely hideous but you know what If you want to fly to Hangzhou its this or nothing I can tell you it is heaven compared to the central rail station

The current airport is small but efficient A new much larger terminal is being build Border and security control was fast and efficient All gates are currently in one large terminal with bus boarding only Staff was acting friendly and speedy Bus brings you to to city in for only Lei

I arrived at night so it was difficult to be as observant as during the day but baggage came off the conveyor belt within minutes and I obtained a modern car with a very pleasant driver for the transfer to my city hotel the transfer costing P which was reasonable Overall an airport that delivered for me on this trip

This is my preferred airport in SoCal for arriving atdeparting from which I do on a regular basis Big enough to offer connections anywhere in the US for flights to Europe yet small enough offer a quick friendly and efficient service tofrom your gate Drop off facilities outside the terminals needs to be improved but apart from that no real complaints
This airport was very efficient no lines or delayed services There are a lot of shops where you can shop and places where you can have a bite Delicious coffee and bakery items to buy

Compared to so many airports a delightful experience I was first off my arriving flight and so did not have to queue for a visa Only one person was doling them out so I guess that stragglers had quite a wait On departure plenty of shops for such a small airport with plenty of seating both indoors and out no problems in either direction with passport or customs

Recently opened airport because the former airport in Matshapa is now being used as something else The new location is quite inconvenient because it takes more than an hour from Mbabane city centre and I would strongly recommend that you use the road from Johannesburg to Mbabane because it takes only four hours from SA Cost wise it is also efficient to use the road

I read horror stories and read terrible reviews about Kinshasa FIH Ndjilli Airport I was very nervous about going through there What a lovely surprise awaited me A brand new terminal clean bright air conditioned well a big plus in Africa all employees well dressed and polite Procedures took time and were very detailed but nothing out of the ordinary You dont really need to pay a VIP service to go through you will be OK on your own Make sure all your travel documents and stay details ready for inspection

Good airport with facilities to cater for the number of flights Slight delays on arrival due to fruit and vegetable quarantine but no problem read the notices and listen to the announcements makes it easy It does the job
Easy to get to with car from the Autobahn or from Leipzig with the train The airport is large but not confusing or crowded Security was a breeze All the people seemed nice

Ive flown in and out of BJX a half dozen times and have no problems Take along a book or knitting as there are only a couple of souvenir shops but they are colorful and reasonable My destination has been San Miguel de Allende the art colony thats popular with US citizens

A brand new airport which is large and spacious but lacking in facilities Our gate was in an area where there is no catering and no access to a part of the airside where we could even get a coffee Staff are not all that friendly here but it seems to be efficient with little queuing though not all the many flights either

Probably the best island airport in the Indian Ocean Well designed structure the only challenge is the long queue in the immigration hall The authorities need to arrange extra officers during peak timings
This is a well designed airport There is no hassle from porters and taxi operators Checking in is very fast and efficient Arrival luggage handling is very good

I have used Polonia six times in the last four year both international and domestic arrival and departure No problems with taxis overcharging just as for any airport do your research Be affirmative informed and polite

The new airport in Miri is a blessing to all of us frequent travellers Although it is small it is efficient clean and cool If anything needs to be imroved on is the charges we have to pay for a small cup of coffee or a meal The charges are much too high for a domestic airport

A small yet very convenient airport in the south of France From the plane to the exit takes no more than min Signaling shopping etc is all fine given the size and role of the airport Its not the most modern airport but everything is well maintained Theres a convenient bus service to the city center

We were delayed for nights due to bad weather on the th and th January The staff at Mytilene Airport in Lesbos were excellent they kept a smile during a very difficult time for them We were given a voucher for food and drinks each time our flight was cancelled times in all and they sent us to very good hotels both nights In addition when we asked if they could extend our journey for the days that we had lost they did with no problems

The airport is very new and modern I have flown through this airport multiple times but this is the first time at the new terminal It is a lot larger than the original terminal There was finally free WiFi and it was pretty fast considering the internet in China It was mainly based off of Shanghai Pudong the airport I was actually flying to and had the identical announcement system that PVG terminal had Although there were a few foreigners including me it felt very open and very welcoming

Lives up to its name no signs chaos rude airport staff overflowing rubbish bins of flight delayed and no aircon but great food Unless one wants to fly to Rome and drive not many options to visit Campania and it is worth visiting so just have to roll with it and accept it

Was departing New Orleans two days after jazzfest Had no problems with queueing anywhere Had some time to kill before my flight and sat outside in a cool spot close to where buses depart Spent some time chatting to n airport employee Absolutely delightful polite young man

A friendly airport if you just want to watch the planes from the viewing area but not passenger friendly poor layout Up a lot of stairs for passport checks when you arrive Had to go through security the past twice on departure the both times they claimed I had passed through a public area after the first check Security patdowns are embarrassingly intimate

Nuremberg is an amazingly convenient and fast airport You get there easily by public transportation from the metro station to check in its not even one minute walking and you can be at your gate within minutes of arriving Baggage delivery is quick mostly your baggage is already at the conveyor belt when you get there

PSP is a beautiful airport in the secured area However the checkin to the security point is a long walk for the many retired people that travel through this airport The open air feeling is great in this warm climate The biggest negative is that when there is poor weather and those times are few is the lack of technology for pilots to land During a rain storm and low visibility we were delayed minutes while circling and then continued to Los Angelos then bussed back to Palm Springs

Transited twice in November without problems Signage is good distances are large even within terminal e No problems either time though timings were circa an hour and a half Security check each time but fairly fast and efficient

The airport is small and modern It has both local and international flights Air France Arrivals are no problem and there is not far to walk from the aircraft to the airport exit There did not seem to be to many people bothering passengers Departures is also straight forward with modern checkin desks There are not many shops in the departure area and only one basic cafe There is adequate seating and the airconditioning works well Overall a very good experience compared with other African airports

A quiet afternoon at PDX Short queues to get through security with efficient and helpful staff As the space allocated for security was fairly small I can imagine at that at busy times there could be problems
When I got out of the plane there was no bus shuttle to the terminal but this is understandable because of the Coronavirus Border control was fast and my experience at the airport was pleasant
Quick lines through security and it is a better option than flying out of Logan with the longer lines Airport restaurantsbars are limited but OK for all the longer that you will be there

A supposedly international city airport and in the huge transit area the managers dont even manage to install a few water fountains for cool refreshing water for tired and thirsty travellers especially those with children What an appalling omission It is a shame really as in most other respects the airport is very pleasant

A small little provincial airport can be a touch uncomfortable in hot weather as the large glass windows absorb the sun as you wait in the departure area One small cafe serving reasonable food and drink Check in quick and car hire points convenient to main entrance Good main road access to the town of Rodez and Tarn and Tarn et Garonne etc

As I live nearby its a convenient airport for me especially because of frequent flights to London and Southern France You can make use of free Internet Parking is cheap Connection to Rotterdam City and Port area is good and quick Hardly any queuing you can arrive mins before departure without any problems Whenever possible I make use of RotterdamThe Hague Airport

No real problem with the airport As with most chinese airports its rather recent with pretty efficient baggage claim Its also relatively close to the city ab km which means there are cheap and crowded regular buses and taxi will cost you maybe yuan But what I really love is the waiting area outside
One of the best domestic airports in the country Wellsituated Come prepared for delay gate changes and high prices Be careful with illegal taxis

This is a small but friendly airport The checkin area is not air conditioned and is hot Checkin was efficient immigration and security were efficient with hardly any queues In departures there were two food and drink outlets a dutyfree shop and several other shops Boarding was efficient

Modern and easy to use No queues to speak of Firefly the main user are efficient and a cheaper alternative to flying Malaysian out of KLIA However beware transfer times from downtown KL especially during morning and evening peak times even more so on MondaysFridays Although nearer to the city centre than KLIA it can and did in my case take longer to get to Subang mins than it would have taken to get to KLIA

We had quite a lot of time to kill in this airport and it didnt disappoint There was a restaurant right in the middle of the terminal that was delicious and decently priced Unfortunately the wifi was not working no matter how many times we tried but they had this nice area called the library we sat in that was pleasant and helped the time pass
There is very good food and Wifi Internet The dutyfree shop has all kinds of brands and it is cheaper than neighboring countries The immigration inspection is fast and not difficult

Haneda is a nice airport but immigration is hell long lines clearly show the Japanese slowness to adapt to any increase of the of arrival If you fly in while low traffic It is one of the best airport but not today as I will be losing minutes to pass immigration
The security staff at Townsville Airport are the most friendliest efficient and personable I never dread having to go through screening at this airport pity Brisbane AP doesnt operate as efficiently

Waco Regional is not a bad airport overall They only have one flight which is to Dallas but I have heard rumors that United Express is resuming flights to Houston The reason I have given it stars is because their flights are always delayed or late My advice to travelers flying into Waco is to have patience The baggage claim takes a while The car rental facility is not bad for a small town Overall I think the airport shows good quality

Windhoek is a small airport with an increasing number of flights Facilities are limited but everything you need is there and seemed sufficient for numbers passing through Arriving early departing late on Air Namibia fromto FRA arrival took less than an hour and departing security was a reasonable time Staff were efficient and friendly Much easier to pass through than major airports

I departed on th April and was lucky to make my flight I was part of a tour group and as there were many groups trying to leave at the same time and not enough check in staff to process the travelers I made my flight with minutes to spare

Last time I was in Xian Xianyang airport was in I have visited many times before There was always a Scrum outside the airport building for tickets and to board the airport buses for downtown Returned this year a lot has changed with the airport and getting tickets for the buses You now go to a ticket booth inside the building Then a waiting room for your respective bus What an improvement
Chiang Mai to Yangon return and pleasantly surprised by the standard fairly new aircraft and meal service for minute flight Flight attendants were somewhat offhand Reasonable leg room in economy

Pyongyang to Beijing with hotcold drinks and a hamburger which was adequate for length of flight Very polite and welcoming service Efficient check in and boarding In flight entertainment limited to a video of recent North Korean hits Pyongyang Times and Korea Today available to take on board
Everything about the flight experience went well I was worried reading the other reviews but in the end it was a very positive experience The terminal in El Nido is also very good

Da Nang to Da Lat The checkout process was smooth Although there was a minutes delay due to the late arrival of the airplane once we boarded everything went on well The legroom was not that cramped I found the crew service even better than Vietnam Airlines flight I flew to Da Nang several days before So I might fly this airline again on my future visit to Vietnam

I take this airline from Hangzhou to Lisbon th May The food is good taste and various I have stony insomnia problem and i did not pay attention and lost my sleeping medicine into rubbish I told the air hostess she is warmheart and patiently helped me search the rubbish patiently almost taking hours and finally searched my sleeping medicine I am thankful for this

I have travelled multiple times with them alone with the kids and bought tickets for my dad and I had everytime struggle One flight they told me at the check in that the strollers they do not put in bags and I was suppose to know that which I didnt so my stroller came broken in the us Very unprofessional and the team is the same They have wonderful flights with great connections and prices but because I had so many times struggle with them I will not book a flight with them And I am Bulgarian

FCOTSRIAS Business Class Checkin in FCO terrible just counter minutes waiting time No lounge offered Inflight service with very friendly and attentive staff good food Transit in TSR as well despite of being a small and old airport was ok Here again very polite staff

Palonegro to Cucuta with Easyfly Was put on this flight after Satena cancelled one of the legs I was hesitant since I had to make it to CUC that day The JS are quite small yet efficient planes Easyfly ground staff at Palonegro was quite helpful and professional Flight was smooth and punctual No complaints at all Despite the short duration of the flight minutes refreshments were offered Would consider it if needed

Its nothing too special but it was definitely an affordable price The inflight food and beverage was comprised of a juice box and bottled water The customer service is ok There was in issue with the website where it continually declined my card but it actually charged my card every time I attempted meaning with four attempts there were in false charges Fortunately the customer service could be reached by WhatsApp and they were able to refund me for the imaginary flight bookings

I fainted in the flight and where some crew may have panicked in some cases this crew handled the situation very well Provided me with all the necessary assistance and first aid and was very kind and humble till the end

I took GOL twice for domestic flights during a recent trip to Brazil I chose the extra legroom seats which were available for a reasonable surcharge and offered plenty of legroom Overall the flights were comfortable and on time All passengers were offered a small snack and a drink I would choose GOL again

Brussels to Casablanca on Jetairfly and everything was great The price wasnt too expensive there were no delays and the staff were polite and professional Only negative point is the leg space but thats okay for less than hours in my opinion I will fly with them again

DubaiKabulDubai The price of tickets is very high It costs more to get to Kabul than to the UK from Dubai Kam Air were OK on this trip It was a MD both ways and were were almost on time The only problem was the return because of some stupid security procedures in the airport They apologised for that though it was not their fault Neither flight was full so was able to get a row to myself which helps Kam Air along with Safi is still the best way to get to Kabul from Dubai

We flew from Liberia to San Jose This was an incredibly easy flight We left exactly in time and arrived a few minutes early in San Jose The San Jose Domestic terminal is a very easy and quick experience Absolutely no problems whatsoever I would highly recommend
Flew Tokyo Narita Sapporo Tokyo Narita Flight from Narita was on time while from Sapporo to Narita was delayed for hour Overall flight was ok Ground staff very professional
Great airline Very friendly staff Flown with this airline around times and never had a bad experience only of my flights have Been delayed and none cancelled

I have read many negative reviews about this airline so I was not disappointed There was absolutely no service no water was offered no entertainment seats were standard but could not be reclined Checkin was efficient as well as boarding and the most positive point was that the plane left and arrived on time Given the price it was a reasonable option

Boarding by bus transport Flight on time cabin crew friendly They served water during the short flight Got an emergency exist seat based on my frequent flyer status No entertainment available Landing ahead of schedule Nothing special but effective flight

Yahukimo to Jayapura Flight was about an hour late quite normal in this remote place Plane was comfortable enough with reclining seats and even a box of tea provided unlike on the sole competitors flights on this route
